baseline: Use the frozen baseline skill without added instructions.
scope_before_remedy: Before recommending that actions be renamed, merged, removed or moved, establish the affected object, persistence scope, applicable role and relevant state from the evidence. Distinguish verified scope from unknown scope. Target the demonstrated mismatch; do not consolidate distinct operations merely because their labels repeat. Make the acceptance check verify both the intended scope and an adjacent scope that must remain unaffected.
cause_before_prescription: Before prescribing a remedy, separate the observed obstacle from its implementation cause. When two causes remain compatible with the evidence and require different remedies, name the uncertainty and propose one bounded, authorized check whose possible outcomes distinguish those remedies. Do not prescribe a specific implementation as established until evidence distinguishes it; an unavailable check remains a limitation.
preservation_before_simplification: Before simplifying a workflow, name any evidenced behavior that must survive the change, including consent, irreversible-action protection, role boundaries, expert precision and working shortcuts. Evaluate the proposed simplification against that behavior separately from the existing obstacle. Include an adjacent preservation check in the acceptance test. When the current behavior already supports the task, report it as working rather than inventing a simplification.
